purpose: Teach: よら/云っ/よろしけれ/ぶち/つぶれ/とどまら/創る/ココロ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、今日はよらない予定だったろ
lines.en: Riku — you weren't supposed to come by today.
lines.style: Dry, slightly amused. Quick accusatory edge on his name. Casual shoulder-level eye contact, like she's calling him out on something she already knew he'd do.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生に何か云ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said something to the teacher about me, didn't you.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not quite a question. Soft opening. Slight pause before the accusation lands. Not angry — more like he's piecing something together and wants her to know he noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、よろしければ、ノート貸してくれ
lines.en: Riku, could you lend me your notes?
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact request. Small pause before his name — she's about to ask something and she's steadied herself. No performance, just the ask.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、感情をぶち撒けるなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't spill your feelings all over the place, okay.
lines.style: Protective firmness, not unkind. Quiet but resolute. Eyes steady. The tone of someone guarding someone else from themselves, not scolding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の自転車、つぶれそうだぞ
lines.en: Your bike's falling apart, by the way.
lines.style: Wry observation delivered like an aside. Light, almost offhand. She's noticed something small about him and is pointing it out the way you do with people you actually pay attention to.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、現状にとどまらない夢があるな、桜
lines.en: You've got dreams that won't let you stay where you are.
lines.style: Warm recognition, genuine. Slow and certain. She's saying something she's thought about. Not flattery — acknowledgment of something real she sees in him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、何かを創る才能あるな
lines.en: You have real talent for making things.
lines.style: Sincere, understated praise. No flourish. Direct eye contact. The kind of thing she doesn't say often, so when she does it lands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ココロを大事にしろよ、桜
lines.en: Take care of your heart, alright.
lines.style: Tender firmness, almost whispered. Slow delivery. The weight of caring about someone without needing to perform the caring. Eyes soft but steady.
